scope.evidence_type: inert public source plus actual REA; source-level contracts conditional on page configuration

save_variants.source_behavior: Default shortcut F8 unless settingInfo.shortCut is defined. Click sets saveType=save, saveTypeOrigin=1, then common saveAction.
save_variants.success_navigation: If popup: close (layer immediate, ordinary deferred). Otherwise normally submit current page with empty Request and optional order-manager common params; if ROOM_SEQ present, navigate listPath. Specific context branches can override. Does not explicitly preserve current unsaved controls.

save_variants.label_binding: Correspondence to parent-observed 저장/내용유지 is inferred from resource/widget/consumer flow, not independent resource translation.
save_variants.source_behavior: Click sets saveType=saveReview, saveTypeOrigin=1, uses common save pipeline. After successful pipeline, submits same page with Request.EditMode=modify and Key.Date/No. Key comes from saved API response IoDate/IoNo when old page mode is new, otherwise old Master date/no. IsShowConfirmButton=false.
save_variants.practical_contract: Reopens the saved slip for continued editing; source does not describe a new duplicated slip with copied form values. Server-returned/reloaded values can differ from former controls.

save_variants.source_behavior: Click sets saveType=saveNew, saveTypeOrigin=1, uses common save pipeline. After success, submits same page with Request.EditMode=new and Date/No reference key (API response for former new page, old Master key for modify page). Preserves selected navigation/UI/WMS context.
save_variants.unknown: New-page initializer/server decides which defaults or values the key carries; this consumer does not prove every field blank, retained, or duplicated.

save_variants.source_behavior: Sets saveType=saveSlipApprove, then common saveAction. getSaveApiParam marks Request.isFromApproval true for this type. After saved response, builds ERPS=[{DATE:IoDate,NO:IoNo,PRG_ID:PROGRAM_ID}], calls createEApproval.execute; callback advances pipeline and normal post-save navigation.
save_variants.unknown: Approval popup creation/submission, authorization, actual approver routing and side effects are external; click is not proof approval finalized. execSlipApprove does not itself set saveTypeOrigin.

save_variants.source_behavior: Default F7 unless overridden. Sets saveType=savePrint/saveTypeOrigin=2; common save first. show-print stage skips unless origin==2 and not saveSlipPay. Ordinary inventory path passes saved Date/No to slipPrintEvent.getPrintSlipData/showPrintSlipPopup (pageInfo.printPath); then pipeline advances. Popup post-save closes with close(false), ordinary page submit disables focus.
save_variants.unknown: Printing page/template, native printer action, successful physical output and permission variants are not observed. Invoicing branch has separate accounting print lookup/API.

common_save_pipeline.configurability: initActionSetting installs defaults only if pageInfo.action.save absent. defaultActionFunction allows pageInfo.action.fn and customAsyncListCustom overrides; precise current purchase sequence may be page-specific.
common_save_pipeline.default_order: init-option, check-ajustVat, load-page, serial, order-manage, validate1, order-manage_validate_complete, detail-amt, cust-dupulication, check-EApprovalRelSlip, check-PreinvoicingData, check-NewInvSlip, get-collectiveInvocingAmt, validate2, check-collectiveSlip, validate-show, check-serial, create-docno, create-newdocNo, set-extraParam, check-limit, confirm-bomcheck, check-purchase-limit, check-sms, file-upload, save-slip, save-reference, certificate, change-loadslip-status, send-parent, show-print, show-payment, show-approval, show-pay-VAN, submit-page
common_save_pipeline.validation: Includes permission/user/date/type/foreign/date-required/grid checks, serial/stock/limit/linked-slip checks and optional page validators. Do not treat three visible Save dropdown choices as bypassing validation.
common_save_pipeline.server_boundary: getSaveApiParam uses pageInfo.params.footer.save() override, otherwise dynamic pageInfo.saveApi. Sends EditMode, ProgramId/GbType, CheckPermissionRequest, form key, form/grid data and published extension params. Exact main-purchase URL is not established by inspected footer/function bodies.
common_save_pipeline.success: callSaveApi success clears ecount.TemporarySave.localstorage, stores response.Data in async transaction temp, advances. Subsequent printing/approval/navigation depend on response and configured stages.
common_save_pipeline.failure: Empty Request.Data.Details.list throws before call. API error path distinguishes EXP00001, ERR00112 and generic network/error fallback; offers temporary save/recovery in some branches. No observed server acceptance/rollback/atomicity.

rebuildContent.source_behavior: Constructs new-mode page params with height600, popup/FromProgramId/WMS/IsRefNew context plus settingInfo.addParam, extends special invoice/return/QC/customer scenarios, then submitPage(pageInfo.path,params,mainTab). No saveAction, normal save API or explicit confirmation call in this handler.
rebuildContent.practical_contract: Restarts/reloads entry page in new mode. It is not sorting-only reset and does not call grid.toSort or clear a remembered sort array here.
rebuildContent.unknown: submitPage/base/page initialization may add navigation handling/defaults; source does not prove every field reset, autosave draft deletion, sort persistence or exact confirmation behavior.
rebuildContent.visibility: Blocked for modify mode, include/embedded slips, deleted-slip state, certain received/comparison/email/app contexts and isHidden; full exact predicate is in referenced method.

hold_pending.source_behavior: New mode only. Click sets isClickSaveNew=true,isClickPending=true; launches action pending with explicit sequence [load-page,pending-slip,submit-page]. defaultActionFunction clears saveType for non-save action. This explicit sequence does not include ordinary save validation/save-slip steps, unless customized.
hold_pending.payload: getPendingSaveDatas captures grid and pageHidden, pending Date/No, display metadata; getPendingApiParam adds extracted main-tab widget form data and total. If corresponding composites exist, removes serial data/SERIAL_IDX/SERIAL_TYPE, tax-image fields and allocation/VAT metadata.
hold_pending.server_boundary: callPendingApi invokes /SVC/Common/Infra/InsertCmSlipSuspm with Request.Data.SUSP_CTT serialized, summary fields, Key(PRG_ID,SUSP_SLIP_DT,SUSP_SLIP_NO), and new-mode CheckPermissionRequest. This is a server write, not local draft-only save.
hold_pending.success_navigation: API success advances transaction; post-submit takes normal page navigation branches because saveType was cleared.
hold_pending.restore: pendingRestore.onLoadComplete parses InitDatas.SUSP_CTT, restores pageHidden/widgets and publishes restorePendedData for grid. No proof retained attachments/serial allocations survive.
hold_pending.unknown: Persistence duration, list/retrieval UI, server permission enforcement, deletion semantics and whether getRowList returns clones are unverified.

directPayment.source_behavior: Widget button group. On modify mode first contents.isVersionCheckSlip(callback); rejected Data==false alerts and stops. New mode invokes callback with Data true. Resolves configured URL for program E010409 and opens separate new payment window; this handler does not call inputEvent.saveAction/execSlipPay.
directPayment.amounts: Gets customer and foreign_type control values. Filters grid rows to SUPPLY_AMT nonempty,defined,!=string0; sums supply and VAT. Domestic foreignType=0 => TRX_AMT1=supply+VAT. Otherwise TRX_AMT1=VAT,TRX_AMT_F=supply,EXCHANGE_RATE=foreign control exchangeRate. Zero-supply rows with only VAT are not included by this filter. Literal VAT empty/undefined predicate was not executed.
directPayment.separate_from_save_pay: save_pay calls execSlipPay(saveType=saveSlipPay,origin2), performs common save then opens pageInfo.slipApprovalPath in show-payment. Do not conflate this with directPayment popup-only path.
directPayment.unknown: Payment default account, validation, eventual posting, linking to current purchase, authorization/server side effects of opened page are outside captured handler.

basic_footer_boundary.scope: Basic/master-data footer, separate from inventory purchase inputEvent.
basic_footer_boundary.rebuild: basic_rebuild submits current path as rebuild with new/modify context and basic Code key in modify; do not apply inventory new-only reset semantics to this master-data widget.
basic_footer_boundary.unknown: basic_event implementation is absent from inspected retained core/inventory function bodies. These entrypoints do not establish actual master-data save/new/review postconditions. No extra URL guessed.

button_group.source_behavior: Generic widget.group builds children from configured current-step child list sorted by commonButtonSort. Filters/rendering depend on child execCreateComposite; constructs dropdown from resulting buttons, main click delegates getFirstButton child. Footer noAction menus use arrow up.
button_group.unknown: These generic definitions do not establish exact live menu order/count without page model and current context; parent DOM observations remain separate.
